title: Pamela fails her trust test while about 70 scout craft watch
place_text: Indian Springs Valley, Nevada (ranges near the ammunition bunker)

tellings.quote: Okay. On that night, on that night, she failed the test.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the 1960s working alongside tall white aliens at a Nevada air base, tells of one night in Indian Springs Valley, on the ranges near an ammunition bunker. He says a being he calls Pamela failed a test of trust that night while about 70 small scout craft watched. He tells it as part of his account of living close to these beings and learning how they behave.
